title: XML Formatter
h1: XML Formatter — Pretty Print and Minify XML
seoTitle: Free XML Formatter — Beautify and Minify XML Online
description: Format messy XML into readable indented markup or minify it to a single line. Runs entirely in your browser.
intro: Paste XML, choose pretty or minify, and get clean output instantly. No data leaves your device.
blurb: Pretty-print or minify XML with one click — private and free.
howItWorks: Paste the XML you want to clean up.
Choose Pretty for readable indentation or Minify for a compact single line.
Press Format XML. Copy the result when you are happy with it.
examples: Turn a one-line API response into indented XML for easier debugging.
Minify a configuration file before embedding it in a smaller payload.
Clean up hand-written XML that has inconsistent spacing.

faq.q: Is the XML sent to a server?
faq.a: No. Formatting uses only your browser's DOMParser and XMLSerializer.

faq.q: What if the XML is invalid?
faq.a: The tool shows a clear error message instead of broken output.
Yes. Standard XML with namespaces is preserved during pretty-printing.
